result.answer:
Amazon.in's return, refund, and replacement policies have different time windows depending on the product category and seller. The main policies are:

1. General Policy: Most items are returnable within the applicable return window (7/10/30 days depending on the product) if received damaged, defective, missing parts/accessories, or different from description.

2. Return Policy Types:
   - 7/10 Days Replacement: Free replacement within 7 or 10 days of delivery for damaged/defective/wrong items.
   - 10/30 Days Returnable: Free return or replacement within 10 or 30 days of delivery, plus full refund option.
   - 10 Day Free Returns & Exchange: Return within 10 days for exchange or full refund.
   - Non-Returnable: No returns, but refund/replacement if damaged/defective/wrong item delivered.

3. Category-Specific Windows:
   - Amazon Digital Devices (Echo, Fire TV, Kindle): 7 Days Replacement only.
   - Kindle Books: 7 Days Refund for accidental orders only.
   - Alexa Paid Skills & In-Skill Purchases: 3 Days Refund only.
   - Inspect and Buy: 2 Days Refund only.
   - Seller Fulfilled Collectibles: Notify seller within 10 days of delivery.
   - Customizable Products: Non-returnable, refund if wrong customization delivered.
   - International Customers: Refunds within 5 business days from delivery date.
   - Non-returnable products received damaged/defective: Contact within 5 days from delivery.

Cancellation: Orders can be cancelled from the 'Your Orders' section before shipping. Cancellation eligibility depends on order status.

Refund Timelines: Refunds issued to original payment method (pre-paid) or bank account/Amazon Pay balance (Pay on Delivery). Timelines vary by payment method.

Note: Returns eligibility is based on account history, and Amazon reserves the right to charge return processing fees or block accounts for excessive returns/cancellations.
